description: Land Acquisition - Katuwana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for the acquisition of specific land lots (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and claimant information) for public purposes. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
